findings.detail: Rechecked Andrew's view of the polo tournament: now says it is a waste of his time, preserving the source's assessment without Russian literal calque.
Rechecked Caleb's scheduling/sunlight remark: natural Russian retains both the schedule and sunlight contrast.
Rechecked 'Caleb's heart drops' physical image: corrected Russian conveys sinking bodily dread and preserves the impossible downward metaphor.
Rechecked Arian's Crown-appointed enforcer claim: now conveyed as Crown's authorization to enforce its decisions, not a technical title calque.
Rechecked author note on obsession: recast without falsely assigning the author a gender.
